versions.description: Initial version

Initial build: waveguide bassoon gen~ + host UI (Scavone cone, MW reed LUT, D4 phase-delay compensation, vibrato LFO, live.dial param controls, live.scope~ + spectroscope~, live.gain~ → *~ 0.5 → limi~ → dac~ 1 2)
Bind live.dial objects to gen~ Params via param_connect; promote live.slider to live.parameter

DSP stability pass: move breath smoother into gen~ (replace line~ with sig~), rectify reed LUT (positive delta_p only), replace differentiator cone filter with DC-blocked lossy reflection (cone_loss=0.85), fix runaway self-oscillation and breath-driven clicks

DSP stability pass: onepole LPF in cone reflection path + bore_damp Param (0-1, fc 1k-8k). Exposes live.dial Bore Damp bound via param_connect. cone_loss retained at 0.85 as overall reflection scalar.

Fix bore_damp shifting pitch: add onepole phase-delay compensation for bore LPF (same analytic form as bell LPF) and subtract bore_pd_samples from loop period alongside bell_pd_samples. bore_fc/bore_a moved to phase-comp block and reused in reflection path. Sweeping bore_damp now changes timbre only.

Replace bell onepole with RBJ 2nd-order biquad LPF; repurpose bell_bright as formant morph (fc 500->2200 Hz, Q 2.5->0.7). Update D4 phase-delay compensation to use biquad analytic group delay at freq_mod.

Fix bell_bright detuning: D4 compensation now uses biquad PHASE delay at freq_mod (atan2 of complex B/A response), not group delay. Group delay overshoots phase delay by 3x near resonance; using it detuned the waveguide loop as bell_bright swept. Phase delay is the correct quantity for fundamental tuning, matches v0.3.1's bore/onepole form.

Move bell biquad out of the feedback loop. The in-loop resonant biquad in v0.4.0/0.4.1 caused the bore to lock onto the filter's resonance instead of freq_mod, detuning wildly as bell_bright swept. Biquad is now a POST-LOOP radiation filter; tuning no longer depends on it. D4 compensation drops bell_pd_samples entirely (bore_damp onepole only).

Add reed-channel RBJ bandpass (DF2T, 2-History biquad) between reed LUT and bore injection; expose reed_res_freq (500-2500 Hz, init 1500) and reed_res_q (1-6, init 2.5) as gen~ Params + host live.dials with param_connect. bore_in_s now injects reed_filt + cone_return.

Route reed BPF post-loop to bell biquad input; bore injection reverts to dry reed_sig. v0.5.0 placed the BPF in the waveguide feedback path, causing reed_res_freq to pull the bore oscillation frequency (same regression class as v0.4.0/0.4.1 bell-in-loop). Fix preserves bore tuning while reed_res_freq/q sweep honk coloration on the radiated output only.

Switch reed BPF to RBJ constant-skirt-gain form (b0 = sin(w)/2) so peak gain = Q. Previous form used b0 = alpha which is the constant 0 dB peak-gain form -- sweeping Q only narrowed the passband without boosting the resonance, making the honk inaudible. Q=1 now 0 dB subtle, Q=6 +15 dB ringing.

Add breath turbulence noise: 4 kHz LPF chiff injected into breath pre-reed LUT, gain-following (scaled by breath_state * noise_amt). New Param noise_amt (0-1, init 0.15) exposed on host as live.dial Air Noise via param_connect. Silence stays silent; sustained tones gain subtle breathiness.
v0.7.0: tremolo via vib LFO (vib_amp Param + live.dial)
v0.8.0: attack chiff transient (rising-breath envelope + 6 kHz noise burst, chiff_amt Param + live.dial)

v0.9.0: register control (Param register 0-1, live.dial Register) biases bore toward 2nd-mode for upper register — cone_return scaled by 0.7 at reg=1, bore_damp interpolated toward 0.6 (less HF loss, favors harmonics). Linear interp; reg=0 preserves v0.8.0 behavior.

pattrstorage preset bank: autopattr discovery + bassoon_presets.json sidecar + preset UI. 4 starter slots (Default/Dark Warm/Nasal Reed/Breathy). @savemode 3 @autorestore 1; writeagain button for manual persist.
v0.10.1: halve noise_amt scale (too extreme at full range)
v0.10.2: internal reed_sig gain reduction (x0.75) early in gen~ DSP chain -- lowers overall output via the physical model rather than a post-hoc output multiplier
v0.11.0: vibrato realism -- delayed onset, rate jitter, AM phase offset, non-sine waveshape
kill reed LUT -- closed-form flow = x*sqrt(max(1-(x/0.85)^2, 0)) replaces 1024-pt Data table + init_flag + peek/lerp
remove deprecated bell_a stub from gendsp
drop redundant noise_env = breath_state * trem_gain; reuse breath (identical at that point, pre-chiff)
v0.12.3: hoist runtime multipliers (0.75 driver attenuation, 0.5 noise scale) into Param calibration; stiff_gain=0.75-reed_stiff*0.45, noise_amt range [0,0.5] default 0.075; presets migrated
Param smoothing: 30 Hz onepole on bell_bright/bore_damp/reed_res_freq/reed_res_q to kill zipper on preset recall and knob sweeps; biquad coefs now read _s smoothed versions
kill magic numbers in vibrato LFO: 0.524 (pi/6) -> HALFPI/3 (both 2nd-harmonic phase offsets); 1.5708 -> HALFPI (AM phase lag). Pure cleanup; gen~ const-folds to identical machine code.
v0.13.2: reed LUT clamp cleanup -- merge 2-line max/min on delta_p into single clamp(delta_p, 0.0, 1.0). Pure cleanup; identical semantics; consistent with clamp() usage elsewhere in the file.
trim version-history preamble + inline v-tags from codebox comments; history belongs in versions.json/git blame
add toggleable reed onset pitch drift envelope (-8 cents, 40ms decay)
split bell_bright into body_formant (fixed peaking EQ @500 Hz Q=3 +6 dB) + bell_bright (Butterworth LPF 1500-5000 Hz). Decouples bore body resonance from radiation rolloff.
replace register hack with true octave switch (period halving + smoothed crossfade); phase-delay compensation now tracks effective oscillation freq
